all_found.desc: [BUG] UninstallHookInstall unsets core.hooksPath first; if removing metareview.stopGate then fails it returns (true, err), and UninstallPreview / the empty-core.hooksPath path treat a retry as already done, so --uninstall-hooks reports nothing to uninstall while pre-finish.sh keeps gating on the leftover opt-in. Raised independently by Cursor Bugbot on PR #195 and the recheck lens. A partial uninstall is unrecoverable through the command that caused it; the Stop gate stays on in a repo the user uninstalled.
